subject: minecraft-1.8.8-trapped-chest-inventory-comparator

observed_source_semantics.trapped_chest_comparator_override: BlockChest comparator input override calls Container.calcRedstoneFromInventory(getLockableContainer(...)); this channel is inventory fullness, not numPlayersUsing.
observed_source_semantics.inventory_formula: For each nonempty slot add stackSize/min(inventoryLimit,itemMaxStackSize), divide by inventory size, then return floor(fraction*14)+(nonemptySlotCount>0?1:0).
observed_source_semantics.comparator_input_resolution: BlockRedstoneComparator.calculateInputStrength examines the block at comparatorPos.offset(FACING) and uses its comparator input override when present.
observed_source_semantics.comparator_signal_storage: BlockRedstoneComparator.getActiveSignal returns TileEntityComparator.OutputSignal; onStateChange stores calculateOutput(...) into that tile entity.
observed_source_semantics.inventory_mutation_notification: TileEntityChest.setInventorySlotContents calls markDirty; TileEntity.markDirty marks the chunk dirty and calls world.updateComparatorOutputLevel for the chest block.
observed_source_semantics.replaceitem_mutation: CommandReplaceItem block mode resolves the target IInventory and invokes setInventorySlotContents for the selected slot.

runtime_hypothesis.fixture_channel: paired exact-1.8.8 fresh worlds with a single trapped chest and an adjacent comparator facing the chest; control chest remains empty while activated chest receives one stone in slot.container.0 through replaceitem
runtime_hypothesis.opening_isolation: the exact-version Mineflayer actor only loads the fixture chunk and never opens the chest in either arm

inference_boundary: This fixture may promote only trapped-chest inventory/fullness to comparator signal behavior exercised by the paired empty-versus-one-item intervention.
Comparator evidence must not be used as a substitute for trapped-chest player-open-count redstone power.
The source formula grounds the exact 1.8.8 0..15 computation, but this bounded runtime fixture exercises only the 0-to-1 transition.
Comparator signal execution is structural/runtime evidence, not player perception, comprehension, legibility, fun, fairness, immersion, or overall quality.
